basis: V2.2 §7.4/§7.5/§7.7/§9.1: landmark relay consumes landmark identity, reference availability, horizontal image bearing, and observation freshness; it does not consume 2D pixel error or world position from perception
post-evaluation diagnosis 2026-11-04: 3px 2D and horizontal bearing diverge (87/181 emitted frames 2D-fail but bearing<=1.074deg)

consumer_contract.observation_valid: accepted observation with valid context/generation; stale/duplicate/generation-mismatch are invalid and counted as rejection
consumer_contract.identity_policy: a confirmed landmark_id (RMUC2027_CENTRAL_TOWER_PROPOSED) may only be emitted when the appearance gate passes AND exactly one candidate survives score/margin thresholds; otherwise output candidate/UNKNOWN and do not update associated regions; GT position, oracle region, filenames and label files must never be used for inference identity
consumer_contract.reference_policy: GT reference visible -> keypoint emission; GT reference unavailable (too small/occluded/out of frame) -> correct refusal (no keypoint, UNAVAILABLE)
consumer_contract.bearing_definition: horizontal image bearing atan2(keypoint_x - cx0, fx); not world bearing, not distance
consumer_contract.freshness: observation freshness/TTL handled by the input contract; invalid observations are rejection, not success

success_definition.per_gt_present_frame: success = presence correct AND identity confirmed-correct AND reference handling correct AND abs(predicted bearing - gt bearing) <= tau_bearing AND observation valid
success_definition.per_gt_absent_frame: success = no confirmed central-tower claim (correct refusal/absence)

thresholds.tau_bearing_rationale: consumer uses coarse region/landmark orientation; fx=160 gives 1 px = 0.358 deg so 3 deg is about 8.4 px; coarse orientation budget, not a certification limit; not reverse-engineered from seen test results
thresholds.tau_det: frozen on validation by the improvement experiment
thresholds.appearance_gate: image features only (bbox aspect ratio, green-light relative height/offset, symmetry) with thresholds frozen on validation; UNKNOWN on failure

denominators.all_positive: all GT-present frames in the frozen split (including TINY, truncation, reference-unavailable, GT-unobservable)
denominators.reference_available: GT-present frames with visible annotated reference point (bearing error denominator)
denominators.negatives: GT-absent frames plus MS1-only and similar-structure frames for wrong-claim accounting
denominators.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN/REJECTED/no-keypoint samples stay in their applicable success denominators and are reported separately by status/reason; never removed to improve success
denominators.tiny_policy: TINY-domain results reported separately (all-domain denominator retained); TINY not reliably annotatable under current sample/method is not a reason to delete those frames

metrics_to_report: identity confirmed claims, correct claims, wrong claims (global, MS1-only, multi-candidate, same-frame, full-occlusion, negatives), identity precision/recall
reference availability: correct declaration rate (GT-visible emission, GT-unavailable refusal), false-reference rate
emission rate, rejection rate by reason, UNKNOWN rate
bearing error median/P90/n on reference-available emitted frames; no-output samples kept in success denominator
consumer success rate: all-positive, observable-positive, reference-available, plus per-family/scale/truncation/negative-type
wrong-claim rate = wrong confirmed identity / applicable negative denominator
2D pixel error and bbox IoU as diagnostics only

stage_gates.note: stage-specific; a later-stage gate must never be applied at an earlier stage (2026-11-04 errata)

consumer_pilot_gate.applies_to: single-seed <=15 epoch pilot vs matched baseline (same split/budget/preprocess)
conditions: wrong-claim rate not worse than baseline
bearing median not worse than baseline
consumer_pilot_gate.on_fail: candidate rejected; do not extend budget

consumer_three_seed_gate.applies_to: winner promoted to 3 seeds <=60 epoch each; report all seeds and worst seed; validation-only selection/threshold freeze
conditions: no separate advance condition: the holdout gate below is evaluated on the val-selected seed after the 3-seed phase

consumer_holdout_gate.applies_to: val-selected model/thresholds/decoder/eval rules frozen after 3 seeds
conditions: consumer success improvement over matched baseline >= +0.05 absolute
wrong-claim rate <= 0.05 on the applicable negative/MS1/multi-candidate denominator
bearing error median <= 3.0 deg and P90 <= 5.0 deg on reference-available emitted frames
reference declaration correct rate (GT-unavailable refusal) >= 0.50 and false-reference rate <= 0.10
worst-group consumer success not worse than baseline worst-group by more than 0.05
consumer_holdout_gate.on_fail: STOP this version: no new holdout capture/evaluation; keep failure evidence; do not claim the architecture/route is falsified
consumer_holdout_gate.on_pass: freeze and capture a new holdout: >=3 new trajectory families, 200-400 frames, covering close-range, far/TINY, truncation, MS1 confuser alone, same-frame target+MS1 ambiguity, target absent; sampling/coverage frozen before capture; freezing model/thresholds/labels/evaluator then exactly one evaluation; failure stops the version

approach_1.description: single-class tower detector + image-only appearance gate (aspect ratio, green-light relative position/height, symmetry) returning UNKNOWN on failure; no retraining

approach_2.description: retrain with a second class for similar structure/MS1
approach_2.why_not_run: new full training would exceed the package budget already allocated to completing the candidate-A 3-seed stage verification; second-class labels not frozen yet

holdout_rules.annotation: frozen spec v2.1+; QA PASS; register who viewed images/purpose/time; same-agent execution is PROCESS-ISOLATED HOLDOUT, not third-party sealed or certification truth
holdout_rules.evaluation: once only after model/thresholds/decoder/evaluator/labels frozen; no callback/retune/rerun

boundaries: shadow only; no control, no PPO, no gate promotion
internal bounded research only; distribution licence decision pending
old 3px protocol and results kept; this protocol is separate and does not retro-validate old results
do not delete hard samples or change denominators to improve the number
